clauses.title: Coverage C – Personal Property
clauses.text: We cover personal property owned or used by an insured while it is anywhere in the world, up to the limit shown in the Declarations.

clauses.title: Coverage E – Personal Liability
clauses.text: If a claim is made or a suit is brought against an insured for damages because of bodily injury or property damage caused by an occurrence, we will pay up to our limit of liability shown in the Declarations.

clauses.title: Loss Settlement – Replacement Cost
clauses.text: Covered property losses are settled at replacement cost without deduction for depreciation, subject to the limit of liability and the deductible.

clauses.title: Deductible
clauses.text: We will pay only that part of the total of all loss payable that exceeds the deductible amount shown in the Declarations. The deductible is $1,000 per occurrence.

clauses.title: Special Limit – Jewelry
clauses.text: $2,500 in the aggregate for loss by theft of jewelry, watches, furs and precious stones. Jewelry remains covered for other named perils up to the Coverage C limit.

clauses.title: Special Limit – Portable Electronics
clauses.text: $3,000 in the aggregate for portable electronic equipment while away from the residence premises.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Motor Vehicles
clauses.text: We do not cover motor vehicles or their equipment, other than vehicles used solely to service the residence premises.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Flood and Earth Movement
clauses.text: We do not insure for loss caused by flood, surface water, earthquake or other earth movement.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Business Property
clauses.text: We do not cover property pertaining to a business conducted on the residence premises.

clauses.title: Eligibility – Business on Premises
clauses.text: Applicants who conduct a business from the residence premises are not eligible under this program.

clauses.title: Rating – Prior Claims
clauses.text: Applicants reporting one or more property claims within the preceding five years are rated with a prior-claim surcharge determined at underwriting.
